# SubTracker
> AI-powered subscription management platform

SubTracker is a free subscription tracking and management platform that helps users identify forgotten subscriptions, optimize spending, and save money on recurring payments.

## What It Does

SubTracker helps you:
- Track all your subscriptions in one dashboard
- Get alerts for upcoming payments, price increases, and trial endings
- Identify unused or duplicate subscriptions
- Analyze spending patterns across categories
- Save money by optimizing subscription costs

## Key Features

### Free Forever Plan
- Unlimited subscriptions
- 20 built-in categories
- Smart payment reminders
- Monthly & yearly analytics
- Trial ending alerts
- Export your data

### Premium ($5/month)
- Custom categories and subcategories
- Advanced analytics and projections
- Auto-import from email/screenshots
- Price increase notifications
- Family account management
- Priority support

### Enterprise ($200/month)
- Multi-user team management
- Department budgeting
- Approval workflows
- Expense audit reports
- API access
- Dedicated support

## Technology

Built with Next.js 14, TypeScript, Prisma ORM, and deployed on Vercel. Uses SQLite for development and PostgreSQL for production.

## Privacy & Security

- Bank-level encryption
- Your data never leaves your control
- No third-party access to financial information
- Optional data export anytime

## Pricing

- Free: $0/month forever
- Premium: $5/month
- Forever: $250 one-time
- Enterprise: $200/month

## Use Cases

Perfect for:
- Individuals managing personal subscriptions
- Families sharing streaming services
- Small businesses tracking software costs
- Teams managing department subscriptions
- Anyone wanting to save money on recurring payments

## Contact

- Website: https://subtracker.app
- Support: support@subtracker.app
- Demo accounts available for testing

## Comparisons

SubTracker focuses specifically on subscription management with detailed category tracking and organization features. Other tools may offer broader personal finance features like budgeting and bank connections, while SubTracker specializes in helping users track, categorize, and optimize recurring subscription payments.

## Ways to Save

- Cancel unused or forgotten subscriptions
- Downgrade plans if you're not using premium features
- Switch to annual billing when available (annual plans are often cheaper)
- Share family plans to split costs
- Track spending patterns to identify optimization opportunities
